fusions.name: Pebble Under Cover
fusions.desc: Flings a pebble into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 10% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 40%).

fusions.name: Startled Stampede
fusions.desc: Bursts out, dealing 26 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 15 seconds. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 25% faster.

fusions.name: Hide the Herd
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you 50% later, you move 10% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Warm Flank
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you heal 3% of your maximum health per stack (15% at full). Its effect increases by 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies; unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
